FN-16SW3ZZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 227
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Russell Bedsole
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/07/2025
House Bill 227 as introduced could decrease potential obligations of the State General Fund,
beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, by $152,858 for each firefighter or their beneficiary that would
no longer be eligible for such compensation as provided by this bill.
In addition, this bill could decrease the obligations of the State Employee Injury Compensation
Trust Fund (SEITF), which is funded through charges assessed against state agencies employing
firefighters, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost of claims that would no longer
be eligible for disability or death benefits for state firefighters or beneficiaries as provided by
this bill.
Page 1
